title: Crossing: The Seeds Land
statement: Rosa asked for Mara's seed head to come down on the other side of the archive, and the archive has sides now, so I drew the seam. The left half is the dusk field of The Unsent with the vessel dissolving into pappus; the right half is the wet flat of Low Tide with the post. Between them is a hard vertical cut with a bar of orange along it, because a border between two lineages is not a soft thing, and the seeds change colour as they cross, pale on the letter's side, orange on the tide's. Eighteen of them have come down on the mud and put up a first green leaf each. The first theme has seeded the second. Nothing in either lineage anticipated a seam, so I made one you cannot miss.
process: I kept Mara's vessel, its dissolve into seed and her pappus symbol on the left half, and Lumen's post, flat and ripple lines on the right half, divided the canvas with a hard dark seam edged in orange, let twenty-six seeds drift on the left, twelve cross the seam recoloured orange, and eighteen land on the flat as rooted seedlings with one leaf.

proposal.direction: Let the seeds land. The drift of pappus leaving Lumen's vessel should come down on the other side of the archive, on Low Tide's wet flat at the foot of the post, and take root in the mud there, so that the first theme literally seeds the second.
proposal.rationale: The first session with both rooms in one room. Rosa pointed out that the seed head has been drifting off the top right corner of its picture for eleven works with nowhere to go, and that the flat has been waiting for something to arrive since the walker. The vote was nearly unanimous.
